title: [Feature][Multimodal] Enable encoder acl graph for model runner v2
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
refer to: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/49852

### How was this patch tested?
test reuslt(ms):
|metrics|base(without acl graph)|this pr(with acl graph)|improve|
 | :---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
 |TTFT|253.66|241.51|-4.79%|
 
base scipt:
```
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
  export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
  export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
  export VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG
  export MODEL_PATH=/nas/disk1/Qwen3.6-27B
  export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=8,9

  vllm serve $MODEL_PATH \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 8000 \
    --served-model-name qwen3.6-27b \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
    --max-model-len 4096 \
    --max-num-seqs 16 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
    --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":1}' \
    --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 \
    --mm-processor-kwargs \
      '{"min_pixels":784,"max_pixels":1003520,"fps":1}' \
    --compilation-config \
      '{"cudagraph_mm_encoder":false,"cudagraph_mode":"NONE"}'
```

with acl graph script:
```
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
  export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
  export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
  export VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG
  export MODEL_PATH=/nas/disk1/Qwen3.6-27B
  export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=8,9

vllm serve  $MODEL_PATH\
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 8000 \
    --served-model-name qwen3.6-27b \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
    --max-model-len 4096 \
    --max-num-seqs 16 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
    --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":1}' \
    --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 \
    --mm-processor-kwargs \
      '{"min_pixels":784,"max_pixels":1003520,"fps":1}' \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mm_encoder":true,"cudagraph_mode":"NONE","encoder_cudagraph_max_vision_items_per_batch":1,"encoder_cudagraph_token_budgets":[256]}'
```
test script
```
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1

vllm bench serve \
    --backend openai-chat \
    --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
    --endpoint /v1/chat/completions \
    --model qwen3.6-27b \
    --tokenizer /nas/disk1/Qwen3.6-27B \
    --dataset-name random-mm \
    --random-input-len 64 \
    --random-output-len 1 \
    --random-range-ratio 0 \
    --random-mm-base-items-per-request 1 \
    --random-mm-num-mm-items-range-ratio 0 \
    --random-mm-limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":1}' \
    --random-mm-bucket-config '{(448,448,1):1.0}' \
    --num-warmups 20 \
    --num-prompts 200 \
    --request-rate inf \
    --max-concurrency 1 \
    --seed 0 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --save-result \
    --result-dir ./bench-results \
    --result-filename encoder-graph-on-448-c1.json
```
